verses.html: A Song of degrees. Many a time have they afflicted me from my youth, may Israel now say:
verses.text: A Song of degrees. Many a time have they afflicted me from my youth, may Israel now say:
verses.title: A Song of degrees.

verses.html: Many a time have they afflicted me from my youth: yet they have not prevailed against me.
verses.text: Many a time have they afflicted me from my youth: yet they have not prevailed against me.

verses.html: The plowers plowed upon my back: they made long their furrows.
verses.text: The plowers plowed upon my back: they made long their furrows.

verses.html: The LORD is righteous: he hath cut asunder the cords of the wicked.
verses.text: The LORD is righteous: he hath cut asunder the cords of the wicked.

verses.html: Let them all be confounded and turned back that hate Zion.
verses.text: Let them all be confounded and turned back that hate Zion.

verses.html: Let them be as the grass upon the housetops, which withereth afore it groweth up:
verses.text: Let them be as the grass upon the housetops, which withereth afore it groweth up:

verses.html: Wherewith the mower filleth not his hand; nor he that bindeth sheaves his bosom.
verses.text: Wherewith the mower filleth not his hand; nor he that bindeth sheaves his bosom.

verses.html: Neither do they which go by say, The blessing of the LORD be upon you: we bless you in the name of the LORD.
verses.text: Neither do they which go by say, The blessing of the LORD be upon you: we bless you in the name of the LORD.
